title: Gunger knows the streets

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can I help you boss?

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: "News from the street?" What am I, "The Daily Hobo?"

pronounText.TextHeVersion: "News from the street?" What am I, "The Daily Hobo?"

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: I'm not that connected. I just talk a bit. And listen more. What do you want to know?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not that connected. I just talk a bit. And listen more. What do you want to know?

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: The Localized Unity Zone. Call it by the proper name. Can't you see all this unity all around us?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The Localized Unity Zone. Call it by the proper name. Can't you see all this unity all around us?

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: I dunno. I don't even know why they're OFFLINE. I mean we can still access The Nets. We just can't call anyone. Apparently it's related to the Localized Unity Zone.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I dunno. I don't even know why they're OFFLINE. I mean we can still access The Nets. We just can't call anyone. Apparently it's related to the Localized Unity Zone.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: The Aseptic? I mean, that's a pretty weak name for a serial killer if you ask me. I miss some of the classics.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The Aseptic? I mean, that's a pretty weak name for a serial killer if you ask me. I miss some of the classics.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: All because of this serial killer. You can't deny it, a serial killer on the streets really gets the blood pumping. Sometimes literally.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: All because of this serial killer. You can't deny it, a serial killer on the streets really gets the blood pumping. Sometimes literally.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: We're all in danger. All the time. From a serial killer though? Nah.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We're all in danger. All the time. From a serial killer though? Nah.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: I look relaxed do I? I don't feel very relaxed. But you people—and by "you people" I mean everyone—you don't understand risk.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I look relaxed do I? I don't feel very relaxed. But you people—and by "you people" I mean everyone—you don't understand risk.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: You have no idea. You know what's dangerous in Nivalis? HOVA accidents. You hear a lot of chatter about HOVA accidents?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You have no idea. You know what's dangerous in Nivalis? HOVA accidents. You hear a lot of chatter about HOVA accidents?

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: Exactly! They're all as real as freezing to death on the streets or getting trampled during a rent stampede, but far less likely to happen. And far more, (forgive the word), "glamorous".

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Exactly! They're all as real as freezing to death on the streets or getting trampled during a rent stampede, but far less likely to happen. And far more, (forgive the word), "glamorous".

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: Street vendors sell maps showing the locations of all the killings. The trendiest cocktail on Seaside Boardwalk right now is "The A-sip-tic". What color do you think it is?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Street vendors sell maps showing the locations of all the killings. The trendiest cocktail on Seaside Boardwalk right now is "The A-sip-tic". What color do you think it is?

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: BLOOD red. The cocktail umbrella has a little knife at the end so you can stabby stab the heart-shaped boba floating on top.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: BLOOD red. The cocktail umbrella has a little knife at the end so you can stabby stab the heart-shaped boba floating on top.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: I think it's all pretty funny. When you're one of a small group at risk of being stabbed every day, it's kinda nice when that group increases to include everyone.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think it's all pretty funny. When you're one of a small group at risk of being stabbed every day, it's kinda nice when that group increases to include everyone.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: More unity, right? Anyway, I gotta go. My friend Marv needs some help at his stall selling knock off performance enhancing augments. See ya later!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: More unity, right? Anyway, I gotta go. My friend Marv needs some help at his stall selling knock off performance enhancing augments. See ya later!

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: "The Spectrum Strangler." "The Ripper." "Doctor Defenestrater". I guess the idea of a great serial killer name is out the window.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: "The Spectrum Strangler." "The Ripper." "Doctor Defenestrater". I guess the idea of a great serial killer name is out the window.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: No. You hear about neural augment logic viruses, skin-stealing androids, radioactive cola drinks and, yes, serial killers.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. You hear about neural augment logic viruses, skin-stealing androids, radioactive cola drinks and, yes, serial killers.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: My friend Petar is currently producing hats with "I survived the Aseptic" printed on them. For after the murderer is found.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My friend Petar is currently producing hats with "I survived the Aseptic" printed on them. For after the murderer is found.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: My friend Petar is already selling hats with "I survived the Aseptic" printed on them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My friend Petar is already selling hats with "I survived the Aseptic" printed on them.
Any news from... the street?
What's happening?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What else do you have to do but gossip?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What else do you have to do but gossip?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What else do you have to do but gossip?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What else do you have to do but gossip?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You just seem... connected.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you think about the LUZ?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you think about the LUZ?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What do you think about the LUZ?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What do you think about the LUZ?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you think the Comms will come back online?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you think the Comms will come back online?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Do you think the Comms will come back online?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Do you think the Comms will come back online?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you worried about the serial killer rumors?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you worried about the serial killer rumors?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Are you worried about the serial killer rumors?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Are you worried about the serial killer rumors?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's a scary time.
It's kind of exciting.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you know about the killer?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you know about the killer?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What do you know about the killer?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What do you know about the killer?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you in danger?
You seem very relaxed.
I understand risk.
How so?
But those are all real.
But those are all frightening.
Serial killers are glamorous?
Orange?
Red?
Gross.
Cool!
That's just good business.
